content: रट् €1 <ab>P.</ab> (रटति, रटित) .²1 To shout, scream, yell, cry, roar, howl; घोराश्चाराटिषुः शिवाः <ls>Bk. 15. 27</ls>; पपात राक्षसो भूमौ रराट च भयंकरम् <ls n="Bk.">14. 81</ls>. .²2 To call out, proclaim loudly. .²3 To shout with joy, applaud. .²4 To ring, sound; कर्णे रटन् कटु कथं न बटुर्विषह्यः <ls>Mv. 3. 31</ls>. .²5 To lament, wail. .²6 To crash (as an axe).
